FiveK.name: MIT-Adobe FiveK Dataset
FiveK.license_note: Non-commercial research only. User must accept Adobe/MIT terms before downloading.
FiveK.role: Expert photographic retouching pairs (Retouchers A-E) for Tier-A calibration.

AADB.name: Aesthetics and Attributes Database
AADB.license_note: Academic use only. Requires accepting Adobe Research license agreement.
AADB.role: Ground-truth attribute ratings for SigLIP aspect probe training.

SPAQ.name: Smartphone Photography Attribute and Quality Database
SPAQ.license_note: Non-commercial research use only. Requires agreement with authors.
SPAQ.role: 11k smartphone photos with brightness/contrast/colorfulness attribute labels.

KonIQ-10k.name: KonIQ-10k Ecological Image Quality Assessment
KonIQ-10k.role: In-the-wild aesthetic distribution for reference pool normalization.

PPR10K.name: Portrait Photo Retouching 10K
PPR10K.license_note: Portrait retouching pairs; requires non-commercial academic research agreement.

DEAR.name: Diverse Aesthetic Assessment and Retouching
DEAR.license_note: 100-pair subset public; full pairwise dataset requires author approval.
DEAR.role: Human pairwise preference on rendering variations; calibration set D_cal.
